cases.title: Range comment reaches the fixer with its exact lines
steps: Start a run with --human-review --web as TESTING.md "Human review" describes
Open the printed URL with agent-browser; the review opens in the right panel
In a changed file, drag along the gutter from the first to the third added line and save a comment
cases.expected: human/round1.json holds the comment with side "new", startLine and endLine of the dragged range; the fixer's prompt (run logs) contains "new lines <start>–<end>" for human-H1-1

cases.title: Comment on deleted lines
steps: Use a fake script that makes a task delete a line from an existing file (see src/providers/fake.ts write/commit fields)
At the review pause, click the + on a deleted (red) row and save a comment
cases.expected: The composer header says "Commenting on line −N"; round1.json stores side "old" with the old line number; the thread shows under that deleted row

cases.title: Suggested change
steps: Select one added line, click Suggestion, edit the inserted text, Preview, then Comment
With curl, POST /review/comments with side "old", startLine 1 and a ```suggestion block
cases.expected: The saved comment shows a "Suggested change" mini-diff; the curl request returns 400 with "suggestion needs side new"

cases.title: Old-format comments still load
steps: Pause a run at review, stop it, edit human/round1.json to hold a comment with "line": 1 and no startLine
graph-execution --resume and open the web view
cases.expected: The comment shows as a one-line thread on new line 1, and GET /review returns it with startLine 1 and endLine 1

cases.title: Suite page parity
steps: Start graph-execution suite --web --human-review on demo/suite as TESTING.md "Suite review" describes
At the review pause, drag-select a range in a file and comment
cases.expected: The suite review diff has line numbers; <suiteDir>/human/round1.json holds the comment with side, startLine and endLine

cases.title: Comments list jumps to the lines
steps: Leave three comments in round 1, press Request changes, wait for the round 2 pause
Open the Comments tab, choose All, click the third comment
cases.expected: The panel switches to Round 1, expands the comment's file, scrolls to the range and flashes it; file rows show 💬 counts

cases.title: Markdown is safe
steps: Save a comment whose body is and [x](javascript:alert(1))
cases.expected: The text shows escaped, no image or link is created, and no dialog opens

cases.title: Earlier-round threads show outcomes
steps: After a Request changes round, at the next pause switch to Round 1
cases.expected: Each round 1 thread shows the fixer note and the reviewer verdict (addressed / not addressed), with Resolve and Reopen
